shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical stone face
figures/signs organized in horizontal registers or rows
justification: A depicts recognisable animals in profile (quadrupeds, a crouching feline-like beast, small reptile/lizard forms) arranged in an overlapping, loosely registered animal frieze, whereas B shows dense rows of repeated small script-like signs with no identifiable creatures. The only genuine correspondence is the generic one of shallow relief marks laid out in horizontal bands on a flat face, which any carving tradition could produce independently.
